parsed.name: 通用串口客户端
parsed.description: 一个非实体的软件通信组件，用于与通过 RS232 直连的实验室或工业设备建立和管理串口连接，并在使用结束后释放通信资源。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component for establishing and managing RS232 serial connections to directly connected laboratory or industrial devices, and releasing communication resources when finished.

actions.description: 关闭串口客户端并释放资源。
actions.description_en: Close the serial client and release resources.
